purpose: Teach: 高貴/光源/放電/腹部/劣悪/乳房/置換/有人

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、高貴なブランドイメージを保て
lines.en: We need to maintain our company's noble brand image.
lines.style: Crisp, commanding. Sharp attack on the opening. Clipped pacing—each phrase lands with weight. Composed authority without anger. Sits back slightly while speaking, eyes steady.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。展示会の光源を演出に活かします
lines.en: Yes. I'll leverage the lighting design at the trade show to showcase that.
lines.style: Measured, professional confirmation. Slight nod of the head on 'Yes.' Steady pace, methodical word choice. Voice carries quiet competence—he's already thinking through the details.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、静電放電対策を工場で徹底しろ
lines.en: We have to enforce strict ESD protocols in the factory. No exceptions.
lines.style: Firm and direct. Emphasis lands on 'strict'—not a suggestion. Leaning forward slightly. Low register, controlled. The tone of someone accustomed to being obeyed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。健康診断で社員の腹部測定も追加します
lines.en: Understood. I'll also add abdominal screening to our health check program for all staff.
lines.style: Alert, responsive. 'Understood' comes quickly—no hesitation. Slightly faster pace than before, showing he's already taking notes mentally. Professional brightness without obsequiousness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、劣悪な下請け労働を許すな
lines.en: We won't tolerate poor working conditions from our subcontractors. Ever.
lines.style: Hard edge underneath the control. Eyes narrow slightly. The word 'won't' carries real conviction—this is personal principle, not bureaucracy. Low, measured, but with steel.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。乳房検診の補助制度を社員に提供します
lines.en: Understood. I'll also look into adding breast cancer screening support for our employees.
lines.style: Rapid-fire, keeping pace. Voice has shifted—he's moving ahead of the boss now, already executing. Slight breathlessness on 'also'—showing eager compliance. Efficient, not rushed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社内システムを段階的に置換しろ
lines.en: Replace the internal systems incrementally. Staged rollout.
lines.style: Tighter phrasing. Clipped cadence—two short directives. No filler. Lean back again, eyes narrowing slightly as if already reviewing the plan in his mind. Voice drops in register.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。有人ドローンの開発も検討します
lines.en: Yes. I'm also considering developing a manned drone program.
lines.style: Confident closing. The 'Yes' is almost automatic now—they've found a rhythm. Slight lift at the end on 'program'—he's genuinely intrigued by the idea. Warm undertone beneath the formality, suggesting the boss hasn't rejected it yet.
